## GRAPHICS

CARDS TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS LIVE TO GAME_ 2.0 *Extended warranty exclusions may apply based on country/region. Product Registration is required within 30 days of purchase on zotac.com.

SPECIFICATIONS

• NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER GPU 
• 2560 CUDA cores 
• 8GB GDDR6 memory 
• 256-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1770 MHz 
• Memory clock: 14.0 Gbps 
• PCI Express 3.0 

DIMENSIONS

• Length: 209.6mm (8.25in) 
• Height: 126.1mm (4.96in) 
• Width: Dual slot (41mm) (1.61in) 
• Box 
• Height: 283mm (11.1in) 
• Width: 218mm (8.6in) 
• Depth: 83mm (3.3in) 

INSIDE THE BOX

• ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER MINI 
• Dual 6-pin to 8-pin cable 
• Dual 4-pin to 6-pin cable 
• User Manual 

POWER REQUIREMENTS • 650-watt power supply recommended • 215-watt max power consumption

CONNECTIONS

• 3 x DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 7680x4320@60Hz) 
• HDMI 2.0b (up to 3840x2160@60Hz) 
• Quad simultaneous display capable 

SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready Drivers 
• Microsoft DirectX 12 API, Vulkan API 
• OpenGL 4.5 
• Microsoft Windows 10/7 64-bit, Linux 64-bit 

FEATURES

• IceStorm 2.0 Cooling 
• Super Compact 
• Wraparound Metal Backplate 
• White LED Lighting 
• Real-time Ray Tracing and DLSS support 
• 4K, VR and HDR Ready 
• NVIDIA® Ansel 
• NVIDIA® G-SYNC®compatible 
• NVLink
